name: Jass (Schieber)
description: Jass is the national card game of Switzerland, specifically the 'Schieber' variant, which is a four-player partnership trick-taking game. It features a unique 36-card deck (Acorns, Bells, Shields, Flowers) and a complex point-tracking system. The game is highly strategic, requiring players to deduce their partner's strength through 'pushing' the trump selection and careful card signaling.

content.text: Jass is the national card game of Switzerland, specifically the 'Schieber' variant, which is a four-player partnership trick-taking game. It features a unique 36-card deck (Acorns, Bells, Shields, Flowers) and a complex point-tracking system. The game is highly strategic, requiring players to deduce their partner's strength through 'pushing' the trump selection and careful card signaling.

Part of the 'Marriage' family of games (related to Marias and Belote). It emerged in Switzerland in the 18th century and evolved into various regional forms. The 'Schieber' (Pushing) variant became the dominant nationalist form in the 20th century.

36 cards: A, K, O (Queen), U (Jack), 10, 9, 8, 7, 6.
**Cards vary by suit color**: German-Swiss (Acorns, Bells, Roses, Shields) or French (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades).

36 cards: A, K, O (Queen), U (Jack), 10, 9, 8, 7, 6.
**Cards vary by suit color**: German-Swiss (Acorns, Bells, Roses, Shields) or French (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades).
Dealer deals 9 cards to each player (in batches of 3).

items.text: Obenabe: No trump; cards rank Ace high to Six low; eights count 8 points each so pack totals 157. Points often multiplied by three.
Undenufe: No trump; suits inverted (6 highest, Ace lowest). Eights count 8 points each. Points often multiplied by four.
Match and counter-match: Team taking all nine tricks scores 257 (157 + 100 match bonus). If the team that did not choose trump takes every trick, their points are doubled (counter-match).
Schilten/Schellen double: Scores in Shields (Schilten) or Bells (Schellen) as trump are doubled; target may be raised to 2500 or 3000.
